$comment: Reviewed, intentional differences from the golden baseline, read by tests/e2e/route-inventory.spec.ts. Only soft fields can be approved: description, keywords, og:title, og:description, og:image:alt, og:site_name, og:locale, og:type, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image:alt. Shape: routes["/path"]["field"] = { "value": "exact new text" | null (removed), "reason": "why" }. Hard fields (title, canonical, og:url, robots, OG image, anchors, JSON-LD coverage, EnquiryRouter intent, print hooks, headers, sitemap order, redirects) cannot be approved here. An approval that matches the baseline again fails as stale. The top-level "visible" list is a review log, not read by the tests: every intentional change to visible page copy, link targets or a recorded deviation from the design spec, as { routes, change, reason }.

visible.reason: C0: one group office routes every enquiry; /contact is the general enquiry form, while /partnerships opens with "Partner with Itemba Group" (critic round 3).

visible.change: 'Start a business enquiry' (hero chevron, sectors routing cell, closing pill) goes to /contact instead of /partnerships.
visible.reason: C0: the same general enquiry target as every site-wide Enquire action.

visible.change: Mobile quick-contact bar: Call, WhatsApp and Email are quiet icon-over-label actions and the one pill is Enquire (to /contact); the Email pill is gone. The tel:, wa.me/ and mailto: hrefs are unchanged.
visible.reason: C0: the plan's 'Call · WhatsApp · Enquire'; the mailto: action stays for conversion tracking and the QuickContact contract.

visible.change: Statement lede: '... under one Itemba structure.' (dropped 'on the Tanzania–Zambia border'); sectors lede rewritten as 'Start from your need: each sector opens onto its service, the company behind it and the way to enquire.'; corridor lede shortened to '..., with direct access to cross-border flows.'.
visible.reason: C0: centred ledes ran six lines at 360px (critic round 3); each now sets in four lines or fewer on a phone.

visible.change: Company tile summaries shortened (Mwanjalisi Oil, Westsides, Itemba Enterprises) to about 130-145 characters.

visible.reason: C0 photo discipline: owner decision to prefer a typographic tile where no strong photograph exists, and never repeat a home tile photograph on the company page.

visible.change: Key figure note 'Three more locations upcoming' removed; the planned-site card is 'New ITEMBA stations' with the panel '3 planned'; the first two strengths merged into 'Runs the ITEMBA stations and UZUNGUNI PARKING YARD'.
visible.reason: C0: 'three upcoming' was said three times within one scroll, and 'managed by Mwanjalisi Oil' twice in a row (critic round 3).

visible.reason: C0: the strengths photograph repeated the home tile one click away; no other strong, non-canopy photograph exists for these companies.

visible.change: Strength 'Four branches: Mpemba, Mlowo, Sogea and Tunduma' replaced by 'Bulk supply for cross-border buyers at Tunduma' and 'Construction supply through ITEMBA-HARDWARE' (the former 'Supports cross-border bulk buyers and construction companies' split in two).
visible.reason: C0: the branch row restated the Branches table directly above it (critic round 3).

visible.change: Deviation: the company hero sets its photograph beside the text (square, 440px column) rather than below it, whenever the photograph is not a 2000px landscape master.
visible.reason: C0: the only strong Westsides and Enterprises frames are phone-resolution portraits (the WESTSIDES signboard, the tanker); a 1068px frame would show them soft. Square keeps the text and the photograph about the same height.

visible.change: Deviation: at 360px the home h1 renders at about 40px, below display-xl's 48px floor.
visible.reason: The no-split rule for 'Tanzania–Zambia' takes precedence: the compound is about 7.6em wide and must fit the 316px line; the h1 still leads every other heading by 1.2x or more.

visible.change: P3 hero: the lede is 'Itemba Group is headquartered in Mpemba-Tunduma, Songwe Region, on the Tanzania–Zambia corridor.' (was the long location summary); the actions are the 'View location profile' pill and 'Get directions ↗' (Google Maps, new tab); the headline sets as a two-tone line.
visible.reason: P3: hero ledes are one sentence of 110 characters or fewer (the company-page rule), so the photograph follows on a phone; the core message (HQ in Mpemba-Tunduma, Songwe Region, on the corridor) is kept.

visible.change: The Songwe Region landscape now shows its credit under the hero frame: 'Songwe Region landscape, Richard grivas / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0' (licence linked).
visible.reason: CC BY-SA 4.0 requires attribution; origin/main never rendered it (assets map).

visible.change: Page sections: the corridor story ('Where Tanzania meets Zambia.', home's section reused) follows the hero; the head office is a card (address, the three companies based there, linked); 'Services connected to this location' gains a lede and each card names the company that runs it; a closing 'Talk to the group office.' band (Start an enquiry → /contact, WhatsApp, Call) ends the page. The three advantage cards moved to the location profile's bento.
visible.reason: P3: the plan's locations page (corridor story, advantages, map facade, credit); the advantages are not repeated on two pages one click apart.

visible.change: Hero: the '← All locations' link is replaced by the visible breadcrumb trail above the footer; the lede is 'Home to the group head office and the Itemba sites, on the Tanzania–Zambia border at Tunduma.'; the actions are 'Ask about this location' (#enquire) and 'Get directions ↗'. Deviation: the hero visual is a typographic panel ('Where the Dar es Salaam supply line meets the Zambia border.' · Mpemba · Tunduma · Songwe Region) instead of the Songwe landscape.
visible.reason: Owner photo rule: use the best photographs sparingly. The landscape leads /locations one click away, and there is no photograph of the head office itself (flags.stateHqIsItembaMpemba), so a typographic tile takes the hero here.

visible.change: New 'At a glance' facts (head office, region, border, reach, companies, sectors); the advantages become a bento with sentence-case titles ('Border corridor access', 'Multi-sector coverage', 'Local operating presence'), the UZUNGUNI PARKING YARD truck-line photograph and a routing cell ('One group office routes every enquiry.' → #enquire); 'Operating companies' becomes a section of three linked company cards with a lede.
visible.reason: P3 Apple-style profile: the same facts and advantages, set as the company template sets its own (glance, bento, cards); sentence case per the design spec.

visible.change: The Google Maps iframe loads only after the visitor opens a closed 'Show map' disclosure (label 'Mpemba, Tunduma' · 'Songwe Region, on the Tanzania–Zambia border' · 'Opens an embedded Google Map.'); 'Get directions ↗' stays visible beside the address.
visible.reason: Architecture §3 map facade: no third-party request or layout cost on load, zero JavaScript.

visible.change: Enquiry section: heading 'Ask about this location' (h2) with the routing promise and three 'How it works' steps; the compact form's own heading is 'Route an enquiry' (h3) with the location description. Default intent unchanged (general).
visible.reason: The company template pattern (CompanyEnquire): the page names the section, the form keeps its standard title.

visible.change: Removed the 'Business enquiries' note sentence 'For sector-specific enquiries, we recommend contacting the relevant subsidiary company directly. Each company operates with its own team and management structure.'; its links move to a closing 'More ways we can help' row of cards: 'Partnership enquiry routes' (/partnerships), 'Frequently asked questions' (was 'Browse frequently asked questions', /faq) and a new 'Company profile' (/company-profile).
visible.reason: Plan and message map: the sentence contradicted the routing model (one group office routes every enquiry; no per-subsidiary contacts exist).

visible.change: Hero gains actions ('Start an enquiry' → #enquire, WhatsApp, Call); the full form follows the hero at once, beside 'Tell us what you need.' with the routing promise and 'How it works' steps; the form's heading 'Route an enquiry' is now an h3 under that h2.
visible.reason: P3 support-style page: every Enquire pill lands here, so the form stays high; the quick-contact bar is hidden on /contact, so the hero carries WhatsApp and Call for phones.

visible.change: 'Find us / Group headquarters' is a bento of contact cards: Phone (both numbers), WhatsApp ('Message the group office'), Email (the 'Business enquiry' mailto; the plain mailto: link is gone), Head office (with 'Get directions ↗'), Postal address; the separate Call / WhatsApp / Email button row is removed (the cards and the form's fallbacks carry the same tel:, wa.me and mailto: targets).
visible.reason: Plan: contact cards from @/content/contact only; one card per channel instead of the same numbers twice.

visible.change: 'Our companies' cards now link to each company page and show the company's one-line lede (were unlinked name + sector cards with a hover state); context cards use line icons instead of emoji under a new 'Why Mpemba-Tunduma' heading, and 'Strategic location' reads 'Mpemba-Tunduma sits on the Tanzania–Zambia border, on the Tunduma trade corridor.' (was '… — one of East Africa's most active trade corridors.'). 'Growing economy' stays hidden (flags.songweGrowthClaim).
visible.reason: Design map: cards that look clickable must be links; no emoji; the plan's one neutral corridor phrase instead of an unsourced superlative.
